columns.name: PracticeEngagementId
columns.description: Identifies each attempt available for a learner to complete a Practice.

columns.name: UserId
columns.description: Identifies the user engaging with the Practice attempt.

columns.name: OrgUnitId
columns.description: Identifies the Brightspace course containing the Practice. Field can be null.

columns.name: CompletionStatus
columns.description: The status of the engagement: NotStarted or Completed.

columns.name: CompletionDate
columns.description: The date and time (UTC) the attempt was completed.

columns.name: Version
columns.description: Indicates the version of the row. This information is used to determine which table row occurred first.
